notes.subject: אל יהוה
notes.rationale: 'long Yahwe' — man i tingting olgeta daun long Yahwe (bikpela nogut long en), o i tingting long pasin bilong Yahwe; olsemtaim translators i makim 'against'.

notes.subject: לא תקום פעמים צרה
notes.rationale: Pen i no ken kirap tupela taim: o pen bilong Nainiva i no bai kamap gen, o Yahwe i no bai traim olgeta tupela taim.

notes.subject: כלה הוא עשה
notes.rationale: Tok 'kalá' i tanim tupela: pinis na binatim; klostu wantaim tok 'כלה' long ves 8 — narapela namba wan i binatim olgeta.

notes.subject: ol man bilong Nainiva
notes.rationale: Tok i go daun long ol birua bilong Yahwe — askim ol direk: 'Ol i tingting wanem?'

translation: Ol i tingting wanem long Yahwe? Em i wokim katim-i-pinis-olgeta; pen bai i no kirap ⟨moa⟩ tupela taim.
